derived.title: The first night the archive remembers
derived.body: Lana Del Rey at 2:50 AM on a web player. 2013. Nobody is keeping a household ledger yet. This is the oldest leaf.

derived.title: Place 0 is not a place
derived.body: The ledger anonymizes the stations. I know them by smell: Dadar at dusk, Sion after rain, LTT when the Patna Exp is being cancelled in real time.

derived.title: Are you up
derived.body: Drafted, not sent. John Mayer was already answering.

derived.body: Typed at 1:14 AM. Refreshed four times. The berth toward Place 3 only exists if you catch it early.

derived.title: Don't wait up
derived.body: Reached Place 2. Sevagram is late, as usual. There is a man selling chai at the door like nothing in the country has changed.
